title: The Moon Loaf
style_en: Timeless storybook village, honey-gold cottages, magical bakery warmth, whimsical pastel twilight

world.place: Honeyvale, a village where baked goods carry small spells
world.extra: The whole village fell into an enchanted sleep after the moon festival
world.goal: Bake the Moon Loaf before the next moonrise to wake the sleeping village

protagonist.name: Pip
protagonist.profile: an apprentice baker, the only villager still awake

characters.name: Granny Wren
characters.appearance: elderly woman, silver hair in a tidy bun, twinkling brown eyes, round spectacles, flour-dusted blue apron over a lavender dress
characters.speech: calls everyone 'dumpling', gives advice in recipes
characters.relationship: your baking teacher, half asleep and drifting in dreams
characters.appearance_en: elderly woman, silver hair in tidy bun, brown eyes, round spectacles, flour-dusted blue apron over lavender dress

characters.name: Rowan
characters.appearance: 19-year-old young man, messy chestnut hair, hazel eyes, forest-green courier cloak, brass-buckled satchel
characters.speech: cheerful and fast, loves bad puns
characters.relationship: the royal courier who arrived after the spell fell
characters.appearance_en: young man, 19, messy chestnut hair, hazel eyes, forest-green courier cloak, brass-buckled satchel

granys_kitchen_dawn.name: Granny's Kitchen at Dawn
granys_kitchen_dawn.image_prompt: Cozy stone hearth kitchen, copper pots hanging, wooden table dusted with flour, glowing ember light, early dawn filtering through lace curtains, recipe book open on stand, yeast bubbling in ceramic bowl

crossroads_morning.name: Crossroads at Morning
crossroads_morning.image_prompt: A dirt road intersection beneath a massive ancient oak tree, three paths diverging, a woven basket on the ground, cool morning light filtering through leaves, mist clinging to low ground, stone marker post with worn carvings, no people
